environments.detail: A continuous matte microcement floor and backdrop, nearly invisible corner line, organic granular mineral surface. No marble.
Two flat fiber-cement panels forming one crisp architectural seam, low contrast fibers, pale half-gray. No freestanding blocks.
Matte gray diatomaceous-earth plaster wall with delicate trowel texture and mineral floor, two intersecting planes only.
Dark gray cast-in-place board-formed concrete wall, subtle straight formwork seams, matte gray floor.
Charcoal slate with restrained linear layered grain, one simple plane meeting a pale gray floor.
Quiet brushed stainless steel wall, subtle horizontal grain, neutral matte gray floor, no decorative hardware.
Smoked gray glass partition integrated into the background, subtle translucent reflection, gray seamless floor, no extra props.
Pale gray polished plaster corner with a sharp right-angle intersection and non-reflective warm-neutral gray floor.
Near-seamless graphite cyclorama with extremely subtle tonal falloff and matte gray floor, no additional geometry.
Finely sandblasted light concrete wall with discreet porosity and faint horizontal joint, matte gray floor.
Off-white mineral rendered wall and fog-gray floor with minute imperfections, two planes only.
Half-gray and charcoal fiber cement planar intersection, fibrous texture visible only in light, no freestanding solids.

compositions.detail: Camera square-on at the screen, symmetric centered hero, eye level. Leave generous horizontal negative space.
Three-quarter view from viewer's left, device gently rotated 12 to 18 degrees around the vertical axis; all screen corners visible.
Three-quarter view from viewer's right, gentle 12 to 18 degree yaw; entire white screen clearly visible.
Lower camera height with modest upward perspective, device remains undistorted and screen readable, centered in canvas.
Slightly elevated camera angle looking downward, screen unobstructed, device clearly separated from backdrop.
Device floating in mid-air with a restrained 10 degree counter-clockwise roll, front display facing viewer.
Device floating in mid-air with a restrained 10 degree clockwise roll, front display facing viewer.
Device slightly left of visual center (within central 40%), generous intentional negative space on right, front display completely visible.
Device hovers subtly above the floor without stands, camera near floor height, a single soft contact shadow below.
Camera frames one strong orthogonal architectural seam behind device, device centered and in clear front focus, no additional props.

lighting.detail: Large frontal diffused studio softbox creates gradual metallic edge highlights and delicate soft shadows.
Low-angle soft grazing light from frame-left reveals mineral surface texture, controlled gentle shadow.
Soft raking light from frame-right illuminates textured architecture and produces faint cast shadow.
Large diffused overhead source, restrained tonal gradients, no harsh or theatrical light beams.
Soft top-left daylight through invisible high window, mild diagonal light transition rather than repeated hard beams.
Soft top-right daylight with broad gentle penumbra and diffused highlights on device glass.
Soft low-key studio lighting on charcoal background, sufficient light to keep product contours readable.
Airy high-key studio lighting with off-white wall and pale gray tones, preserve contrast around white screen.
